title: Guide's son claims his father led Armstrong down the wrong path

tellings.quote: They didn't find it. But I'm in touch with this guy who claims that his father led Neil Armstrong down the wrong path.
And my friend Luis Felipe San Salvador says that his father sent Neil Armstrong in the wrong direction and that he has the real location of this thing.
tellings.difference: Names the son as Luis Felipe San Salvador and adds that the family has maps and knows the real location.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same claim that a guide's son says his father sent Armstrong the wrong way in the search for the Tayos cave.

as_told.title: San Salvador family maps; father sent Armstrong the wrong way

plain: When the astronaut Neil Armstrong explored the Tayos Cave in Ecuador in 1975, his guide deliberately sent him the wrong way, so the expedition never found what it was looking for. Michels says he is in touch with the guide's son, who claims this. In one telling Michels names the son as his friend Luis Felipe San Salvador and adds that he says he knows the real location of the thing. If true, whatever was sought in the cave would still be there, and the family would know where.
